title: My Family, friends and I
_source: English for Today, Class Two (NCTB). Unit 8, book pages 75-83.
_note: Mita's passage, her mother, father and brother, the Family rhyme and the exercises are transcribed from the textbook. Bangla meanings are Pickixo's addition - the book carries no glosses. The 'who is who' kinship rounds in Lesson 5 are Pickixo's teaching addition.

steps.title: Family
verses: Come with me, and meet my family
Mother, father, sister, brother and me.
